Question 3

Which of the following expressions gives all of the vertical asymptotes of the function f(x)=cot⁡(2x−π4)? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=π6+2nπ
b
x=π2+4nπ
c
x=π8+nπ2
d
 x=π4+nπ8
e
x=π3+nπ
